Leadership & Growth

  • Help define engineering standards (coding style, testing, CI/CD) for our international team.

  • Model best practices in communication, collaboration, and technical execution.

Qualifications

Must-Have

  • 7+ years as a Full Stack Engineer, with strong backend focus (70/30 backend/frontend split preferred).
  • Experience in SaaS development, ideally in B2B or infrastructure-heavy environments.
  • Proficiency in Node.js/Express with TypeScript.
  • Advanced PostgreSQL skills (schema design, queries, indexing, optimization).
  • Track record of end-to-end project ownership (database to production).
  • Experience writing and maintaining unit and integration tests.
  • Active contributor to code reviews and improving team code quality.
  • Proven ability to deliver high-quality results under tight deadlines.
  • Strong collaboration skills with PMs, designers, and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Written and spoken fluency in English.

Nice-to-Have

  • Frontend expertise in React/Next.js.
  • Experience building integration test frameworks.
  • Prior mentorship or leadership experience.
  • Experience working in high-growth startups, navigating fast-moving environments, evolving priorities, and scaling engineering teams or products.

Why Join Revv?

  • Own end-to-end features that immediately impact customers.

  • Clear path into mentorship and engineering leadership.
  • Work at the intersection of AI, automotive safety, and SaaS innovation.

For over 50 years we have been working with clients around the world and in diverse industry sectors to help them to understand and manage their environmental, health, safety, risk and social impacts. The key sectors we serve include Oil & Gas, Mining, Power, and Manufacturing, Chemical and Pharmaceutical. All face critical sustainability challenges and our clients in these and many other areas rely on our ability to assist them operate more sustainably which has a positive impact on our planet.

Colaboração Técnica: Atuar como ponto de referência para equipes de desenvolvimento, BI e ciência de dados, oferecendo suporte e expertise em questões relacionadas à estrutura e acesso aos dados.

Domínio avançado e estratégico de práticas de modelagem e arquitetura de dados, incluindo Data Vault e outros padrões modernos.

Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: São Paulo, State of São Paulo, Brazil; Belo Horizonte, State of Minas Gerais, Brazil .

Minimum qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 8 years of experience in software development, and with data structures/algorithms.
  • 5 years of experience testing, and launching software products, and 3 years of experience with software design and architecture.
  • Ability to communicate in English and Portuguese fluently.

Preferred qualifications

  • 4 years of experience in a technical leadership role.
  • 2 years of experience managing teams of software engineers.
  • Experience designing and implementing any of the following: large-scale distributed systems, APIs used by other developers, Search Ranking systems, ML (Machine Learning) systems.

About The Job

Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

Google is an engineering company at heart. We hire people with a broad set of technical skills who are ready to take on some of technology's greatest challenges and make an impact on users around the world. At Google, engineers not only revolutionize search, they routinely work on scalability and storage solutions, large-scale applications and entirely new platforms for developers around the world. From Google Ads to Chrome, Android to YouTube, social to local, Google engineers are changing the world one technological achievement after another.

Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, test, deploy, maintain, and improve software.
  • Research, conceive, and develop software applications to extend and improve on Google's product offering.
  • Collaborate on scalability issues involving access to data and information.
  • Manage individual and team priorities, deadlines, and deliverables.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

title: Crew Analyst – Talent Attraction
description:
Join to apply for the Crew Analyst – Talent Attraction role at Maersk Supply Service

Join to apply for the Crew Analyst – Talent Attraction role at Maersk Supply Service

At Maersk Supply Service, we believe that crewing is more than logistics—it’s about people. We’re looking for a Crew Analyst who shares our commitment to openness, collaboration, respect and to build a trustful relationship with all stakeholders, especially our offshore colleagues. If you’re someone who values transparent communication and wants to make a meaningful impact on the lives of our offshore colleagues, we’d love to hear from you.

Who are we?

At Maersk Supply Service (MSS), we’re more than a marine solutions provider—we’re a team of people who genuinely care about doing things right. Based in Rio de Janeiro, you’ll be welcomed into a close-knit HR & Crewing team that thrives on collaboration, open dialogue, and mutual respect. You’ll work alongside colleagues from across the organisation, each bringing their own expertise to help us navigate the complexities of the energy sector with integrity, safety, and purpose.

We enjoy what we do! We have a flexible and energized work environment. Here, ideas are not just heard—they’re valued. We celebrate our diverse backgrounds and see them as a true source of strength. We work close together, humbling listening and learning from each other, and overcoming challenges together, “we” should come before “I”. Every day, we strive to create a supportive space where your voice matters and your contributions lead to real change. This role is a unique blend of operational excellence and human connection.

As a company, we are owned by A.P. Moller Holding, operating independently with the trust and empowerment to do what is right for us, while proudly bearing the Maersk name and values.

What You Will Be Doing

The crewing department includes several HR subsystems, and as a Crew Analyst – Talent Attraction – you’ll play a key role in shaping the future of our MSS operations.

You’ll drive alignment on talent attraction strategies and process along with the Crew Manager, will execute the talent attraction process, and build a sustainable pool of skilled professionals by leading our cadet programme—supporting the growth and development of new seafarers and helping them thrive in their maritime careers.

Who You Are

First and foremost, you are passionate about the maritime industry, talent attraction and enjoy building up trusted relationships, and you recognize the game-changing potential by working in crewing and the positive effect that you can bring to people’s life. In addition, we hope you can say yes to the following:

  • Proficiency in verbal and written English and Portuguese.
  • Bachelor’s degree in psychology, Administration or related areas.
  • MBA in Human Resource is preferable for this position.
  • 3 years of previous experience in similar roles. Previous roles in the Maritime industry would be an advantage.
  • Has a strategic mindset and understands how talent drives business success.
  • Build strong networks and knows how to attract top talent through authentic engagement.
  • Communicates with clarity and impact—whether crafting employer branding or engaging with candidates.
  • Makes quality decisions quickly and confidently, even in fast-paced environments.
  • Champions diversity and inclusion, valuing different perspectives and backgrounds.
  • Is customer-focused, always thinking about the candidate experience.
  • Thrives on collaboration, influencing stakeholders and aligning hiring needs across teams.
  • Operational Excellence: Strong attention to detail in managing crew data, cost control, and vessel planning, ensuring smooth and compliant operations.
  • Process Improvement & Quality Focus: Proactive in identifying opportunities to enhance procedures and energise the team through continuous improvement.

How to Apply

If you can imagine yourself in this role, we look very much forward to hearing from you. Please apply through our website no later than 12 September 2025. We will review and interview on an ongoing basis, so please apply as soon as possible.

  • Stellar product‑market fit with tons of customer love.
  • All‑star team with diverse backgrounds to collaborate with and learn from.

  • Habilidade com planilhas, metas e apresentações de resultado.
  • Vivência com gestão de parcerias, eventos e relacionamento B2B.

RELACIONAMENTO HIERÁRQUICO

  • Reporta-se diretamente à: Diretoria

Garantir o crescimento contínuo da Elite Clinic, fortalecendo a marca através de resultados comerciais sólidos, relacionamentos estratégicos e uma experiência memorável para o paciente.

A 2easy é uma empresa inovadora que está na vanguarda da criação de conteúdo com Inteligência Artificial. Local de Trabalho: Presencial em Jundiaí, SP.

Objetivo da Função

Como AI Video Creator, você atuará na criação, edição e evolução de vídeos gerados com Inteligência Artificial. Seu trabalho combinará engenharia de prompts, o uso de ferramentas avançadas de IA para vídeo, imagem e voz, e técnicas de edição para entregar conteúdos realistas, bem finalizados e prontos para uso em campanhas, redes sociais e testes de performance da 2easy.

Perfil que Buscamos

  • Extremamente curioso sobre IA: Você está sempre explorando as últimas tendências e ferramentas.
  • Proativo e autodidata: Já testa ferramentas por conta própria e tem um portfólio de experimentos.
  • Ágil e adaptável: Gosta de aprender rápido, não tem medo de errar e itera com velocidade.
  • Detalhes e refinamento: Tem paciência para ajustes finos e um olhar crítico para o refinamento visual.

Conhecimentos Técnicos Essenciais

  • Inglês Avançado: Leitura, escrita e conversação fluentes são fundamentais para acompanhar as inovações e interagir com a comunidade global de IA.
  • Inteligência Artificial (Prática Obrigatória):
    • Engenharia de Prompts: Habilidade para criar e refinar prompts para obter os resultados desejados.
    • Prompts Avançados para Vídeo e Imagem: Conhecimento para ajustes de estilo, cenário, iluminação, ritmo e expressões.
    • Ferramentas de IA para Imagem: Experiência com ferramentas como Gemini, Midjourney, ou outras para a criação e variação de visuais.
    • Voz com IA: Experiência com clonagem e uso de voz com ElevenLabs ou similares, com foco em ajuste de entonação, pausas e naturalidade.
    • Capacidade de Teste e Evolução: Mais importante que dominar uma única ferramenta, é saber testar, comparar resultados e evoluir prompts.
  • Edição de Vídeo:
    • CapCut: Proficiência na ferramenta é essencial.
    • Edição com IA: Conhecimento de ferramentas de edição que utilizam IA.
    • Técnicas de Edição: Corte e montagem manual, sincronização de áudio, ajustes de ritmo e lipsync.

Desejáveis

  • Ferramentas de IA para Vídeo: Experiência com ferramentas emergentes como Veo, Sora, entre outras, é um grande diferencial.
  • Noções de Narrativa e Estética:
    • Enquadramento e ritmo narrativo.
    • Continuidade visual e acabamento para vídeo final.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Criação de Vídeos com IA: A partir de vídeos base, áudios ou roteiros fornecidos pelo time.
  • Desenvolvimento e Teste de Prompts: Criar prompts avançados para variação de cenário, narrativa e diferentes versões de copy.
  • Edição e Finalização: Realizar cortes, sincronização de áudio, ajustes visuais e refinamento de lipsync.
  • Pesquisa e Inovação: Testar novas ferramentas e atualizações no campo da IA para vídeo.Documentação: Registrar aprendizados, melhores práticas, e o que funciona ou não.
  • Organização: Manter arquivos, versões e a biblioteca de conteúdos organizados.

Diferenciais

  • Já ter criado vídeos com avatares ou pessoas geradas por IA.
  • Noções básicas de design ou composição visual.

Se você é um entusiasta de IA com um olhar criativo e técnico, e quer fazer parte de uma equipe que está moldando o futuro do conteúdo em vídeo, queremos conhecer você!

title: Gerente comercial

MISSÃO DO CARGO

Garantir o crescimento sustentável da clínica, através da gestão estratégica do funil comercial, da liderança de equipe, da fidelização de pacientes e do desenvolvimento de parcerias externas , assegurando que cada experiência de atendimento reflita o padrão de excelência da Elite Clinic.

A gerente comercial deve unir visão analítica, empatia e foco em resultados , conduzindo o time e as ações comerciais com propósito e alta performance.

RESPONSABILIDADES PRINCIPAIS

1. Gestão Comercial

  • Gerir o funil de vendas completo (pré-agendamento → consulta → fechamento → pós-venda → fidelização).
  • Acompanhar diariamente os indicadores de performance : agendamentos, conversões, faturamento e upsell.
  • Criar e executar estratégias de recall e reativação de pacientes , principalmente nos períodos de menor fluxo.
  • Garantir o uso correto dos roteiros e processos comerciais padronizados no Kommo e demais sistemas.
  • Validar todos os orçamentos antes do envio ao paciente e acompanhar o fechamento financeiro junto ao time comercial.

2. Gestão de Equipe

  • Liderar e desenvolver os times de Comercial 1, Comercial 2, Sucesso do Cliente e Pós-venda .
  • Realizar reuniões semanais de alinhamento e resultado , com foco em metas e plano de ação.
  • Monitorar o desempenho individual, fornecendo feedbacks e treinamentos de melhoria contínua.
  • Incentivar a cultura de colaboração, comprometimento e entrega de resultados.

3. Parcerias Estratégicas

  • Desenvolver e gerenciar parcerias comerciais e institucionais com empresas, academias, salões, influenciadores, laboratórios, e profissionais da área da saúde e estética.
  • Criar ações de co‑branding e indicação mútua , fortalecendo o posicionamento premium da marca.
  • Acompanhar os resultados de cada parceria (número de leads gerados, conversões, faturamento e retorno de imagem).
  • Garantir que todas as parcerias estejam alinhadas à visão, valores e público‑alvo da Elite Clinic.
  • Apresentar relatórios mensais de performance de parcerias à diretoria médica, com análise de ROI e plano de expansão.

4. Integração Estratégica

  • Trabalhar em conjunto com o marketing , acompanhando a performance das campanhas e qualidade dos leads.
  • Participar das definições de metas comerciais e campanhas sazonais com a diretoria médica.
  • Garantir a integração entre recepção, enfermagem e equipe médica , evitando falhas na jornada do paciente.
  • Auxiliar na criação de campanhas internas e externas para aumento de vendas e engajamento.

5. Pós‑venda e Fidelização

  • Supervisionar o acompanhamento pós‑consulta e garantir a continuidade dos pacientes ativos.
  • Criar ações de fidelização e indicação (NPS, Google Review, programas de vantagens, vouchers e experiências).
  • Mapear oportunidades de upsell e cross‑sell para protocolos complementares (laser, estética, implantes, soroterapia, nutrição, etc.).

INDICADORES DE DESEMPENHO (KPIs)

  • Taxa de conversão de leads → mínimo 60%
  • Taxa de fechamento de protocolos → mínimo 40%
  • Faturamento mensal → meta definida pela diretoria
  • Taxa de reativação de pacientes → mínimo 30%
  • Satisfação do paciente (NPS) → mínimo 90%
  • Retorno sobre parcerias (ROI) → mínimo 3x

COMPETÊNCIAS ESSENCIAIS

  • Liderança inspiradora e foco em resultado
  • Comunicação clara e empática
  • Capacidade analítica e visão estratégica
  • Gestão de pessoas e negociação
  • Inteligência emocional e adaptabilidade
  • Networking e visão de negócios

REQUISITOS

  • Experiência anterior em gestão comercial de clínicas médicas, estética ou saúde premium.
  • Conhecimento em CRM (Kommo, RD Station, Pipedrive ou similares).
  • Habilidade com planilhas, metas e apresentações de resultado.
  • Vivência com gestão de parcerias, eventos e relacionamento B2B.

RELACIONAMENTO HIERÁRQUICO

  • Reporta‑se diretamente à: Diretoria
  • Supervisiona: Comercial 1, Comercial 2, Sucesso do Cliente, Pós‑venda e Recepção

OBJETIVO FINAL

Garantir o crescimento contínuo da Elite Clinic, fortalecendo a marca através de resultados comerciais sólidos, relacionamentos estratégicos e uma experiência memorável para o paciente.

description:
About the Company

Utopia is a forward-thinking global real estate development group dedicated to creating a distinctive portfolio of luxurious and high‑end hospitality assets. Founded in 2023, our in‑house architectural firm, Utopia Design, is at the heart of our mission to create a global portfolio of luxurious, high‑end hospitality destinations. As part of a growing real‑estate development group, Utopia Design brings bold vision and innovative thinking to every project we take on. We are a young, ambitious team driven by creativity, excellence, and the belief that great design transforms the way people live, travel, and connect.

About the Role

We are looking for dynamic and experienced Design Engineers to support ongoing design development of several luxury projects worldwide focusing on boutique hospitality assets. This role requires a creative and technical professional who can deliver efficient and innovative engineering solutions while maintaining the aesthetic and functional standards expected in luxury developments. In this role, you will be responsible for design development of luxury villas and boutique hotels engineering systems. You should work independently throughout the day, coordinate with the team when needed, and deliver intermediate results weekly. You will report to an MEP design manager, but collaborate with the entire design team, including architects, interior designers, structural engineers, the FF&E procurement team, and client representatives.

To succeed in this role, you should have excellent communication and presentation skills, be punctual, detail‑oriented, self‑organized, and motivated to deliver quality results.

Ideal Candidate

  • Degree in Civil or Building Engineering with a concentration in HVAC and mechanical systems
  • Between 5 to 10 years of engineering design experience working for a design consultancy or a general contractor
  • Experience in high‑end hospitality projects, like 5‑star hotels and private villas

Responsibilities

  • Design engineering systems for luxury villas and boutique hotels, ensuring compliance with local building codes and industry standards
  • Collaborate closely with architects, interior designers, and other engineers to integrate systems seamlessly into the overall project
  • Proactively participate in spatial coordination with architectural and structural models, research efficient methodologies, equipment, and systems to secure the initial design intent and high‑end user experience
  • Timely resolve technical issues and challenges during the design phase
  • Lead the development of detailed drawings, technical documentation, and system specifications using CAD and BIM tools, with the support of BIM modelers
  • Perform load calculations, energy modeling, and system sizing to optimize performance and energy efficiency
  • Oversee equipment selection, ensuring it aligns with project requirements and sustainability goals
  • Provide input during value engineering discussions to achieve the best balance between cost, quality, and performance
  • Supervise the design development, review and approve deliverables of third‑party designers, consultants, surveyors
  • Stay updated on the latest technologies, trends, and regulations related to HVAC systems in the luxury and hospitality sectors

CV Requirements

  • Degree in Civil or Building Engineering with a concentration in HVAC and mechanical systems
  • 8 to 15 years of experience in design consultancy or general contractor
  • Experience working on low‑rise residential and hospitality projects – private homes and villas, hotels, and resorts
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills
  • Proficiency in Revit and AutoCAD
  • Professional level of English, both written and verbal
  • Good to have: Spanish
  • Experience in projects in the Caribbean region

Mid‑Senior level

title: Engineering Manager - Feegow (100% remote friendly in Brazil)
description:
Engineering Manager - Feegow (100% remote friendly in Brazil)

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

Welcome to the good side of tech . You might have heard about us but with a different name: Feegow, Doctoralia or Docplanner. The names are different depending on the country we are located in, but we are all part of Docplanner Group.

It all started over 12 years ago when we asked ourselves: is anyone in healthcare thinking about patients? We jumped in and we empowered patients by giving them access to leave and read reviews about their visit. We then provided doctors with the technology to manage bookings easily and save time, so they could devote themselves to what they always wanted: treating patients. And today is the day in which we ask you: wanna join us in the next step of making the healthcare experience more human?

Where does Feegow fit here?

In 2022 Feegow joined the Docplanner Group, a health‑tech company. We are dedicated to developing innovative solutions and promoting access to top‑tier management for physicians seeking to take their practices to the next level, as well as managers in search of a robust solution that covers end‑to‑end operations. Our ultimate goal is to create a world where everyone can access high‑quality healthcare.

Docplanner Group at scale

We are leaders in 13 countries so far, and more than 80 million patients trust us every month. 130,000 specialists believe in us and our product, and so do leading venture capital funds such as Point Nine Capital, Goldman Sachs Asset Management, and One Peak Partners. And yet, employing over 2,500 people all over the globe, we managed to keep the startup‑mindset we started with over 10 years ago.

And why should you join us?

Because it feels good to tell your family and your friends how you made the world a little bit better. You go to bed knowing that what you do matters, and that your talents align with your beliefs.

We want to make the healthcare experience more human, and that starts with you being you. We believe that considering the diversity of human experience makes a better healthcare experience for all. We’re not just different: we embrace diversity. We will encourage you to come to work your whole self, and that includes not coming to the office at all if you prefer not to, as we’re 100% remote‑friendly (you will work 100% from home, but you will also be welcome in our offices in Curitiba and Rio de Janeiro).

Role

As an Engineering Manager in this group, you’ll be fully responsible and accountable for managing your team(s), ensuring predictable, high‑quality delivery with high operational standards. You’ll also actively partner with your Product counterparts and Staff Engineers to shape the direction of our area and the company as a whole. The role reports directly to the Engineering Director.

We are committed to continuous improvement, open feedback, and working efficiently towards our goals. This role provides an opportunity to influence the strategic direction of the area while receiving mentorship and support as needed.

While expertise in specific technologies isn’t required, this is a technical role, and a solid technical background is essential to effectively support the teams.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Lead and represent ~10 direct reports in total, organized in smaller multi‑disciplinary teams.
  • Provide accountability for all the initiatives of your teams.
  • Work closely with the technical leaders of the group and the area to develop an effective technical strategy.
  • Act as a point of reference for our Leadership team and for the main stakeholders of your teams.
  • Provide guidance, mentorship, and coaching inside the team, through regular feedback and performance assessments.

Qualifications

You’re likely a great fit for this role if you

  • Have a solid technical background related to the whole SDLC and can support and unblock your teams in complex technical discussions.
  • Have experience in modernizing legacy systems to modern architectures as well as leading teams’ ways of working.
  • Comfortable communicating in written and verbal English across global teams.
  • Approach software development with a lean, proactive, and positive mindset, balancing impact and long‑term sustainable development, with a strong accountability for delivering high‑quality solutions.
  • Embrace the “you build it, you run it” philosophy.
  • Believe in continuous learning and improvement.
  • Are driven to lead and nurture high‑performing and healthy teams.
  • Have experience not only mentoring others but also developing future mentors and leaders.
  • Previous experience in consulting is a plus.

Important: Docplanner is an international English‑first company. Therefore, please be sure to send your CV in English.

Additional Information

  • Working hours are from Monday to Friday, from 9 am to 6 pm;
  • We have compensatory time off (Banco de Horas);

  • Medical, Dental, and Group Life Insurance;

title: Concurso da Camara dos Deputados: Prazos, Vagas e Salários
description:
Overview

O concurso da Camara dos Deputados é uma oportunidade para ingressar no serviço público federal com estabilidade e bons salários. É importante conhecer as etapas do processo seletivo, desde a publicação do edital até a prova final, bem como os requisitos, cargos disponíveis e conteúdo programático para traçar um plano de estudos eficiente. Candidatos que se preparam de forma estratégica aumentam as chances de sucesso, enquanto a falta de organização pode comprometer o desempenho. Acompanhar notícias e atualizações sobre o concurso da Camara dos Deputados ajuda a manter-se informado sobre prazos, inscrições e alterações.

Estudar de forma planejada, simular provas anteriores e utilizar materiais confiáveis são passos essenciais para se destacar. Investir tempo e disciplina transforma a concorrência em uma oportunidade real de conquistar uma vaga e iniciar uma carreira sólida no serviço público.

O que é o Concurso da Câmara dos Deputados?

O concurso da Camara dos Deputados é um processo seletivo público que visa preencher vagas em diferentes cargos dentro da instituição, oferecendo estabilidade, benefícios e salários atrativos. Ele abrange oportunidades para diversas áreas, desde técnicos administrativos até especialistas em setores específicos do serviço público.

No dia 30 de dezembro de 2025, a Câmara dos Deputados publicou a disponibilização do concurso, apresentando opções atrativas para os candidatos. O concurso segue normas rigorosas do regime jurídico federal, assegurando transparência e igualdade de condições. Cada edição apresenta um edital detalhado, que especifica cargos, número de vagas, requisitos, etapas do processo e conteúdo das provas.

O concurso se destaca ao ser uma porta de entrada para carreira sólida no serviço público, proporcionando crescimento profissional, estabilidade financeira e benefícios como auxílio-alimentação e plano de saúde. Compreender a estrutura e o funcionamento do concurso da Camara dos Deputados é o primeiro passo para uma preparação eficiente.

Cargos e Salários Oferecidos

O concurso da Camara dos Deputados disponibiliza diferentes cargos com atribuições específicas, requisitos variados e faixas salariais próprias. A princípio, conhecer essas informações ajuda o candidato a avaliar quais oportunidades estão mais alinhadas ao perfil profissional e aos objetivos financeiros. Os salários e benefícios tornam o concurso atrativo, com remuneração competitiva e a estabilidade típica do serviço público. Entender o número de vagas e a distribuição entre os cargos permite planejar a inscrição e a preparação.

  • Analista Legislativo (Proc. Legislativo e Gestão) — 35 + 35 vagas, Remuneração: R$ 30.853,99, Jornada: 40h/semana
  • Técnico Legislativo (Assist. Legislativo e Adm.) — 35 + 35 vagas, Remuneração: R$ 21.008,19, Jornada: 40h/semana

Requisitos e Inscrições

Com base no edital, os requisitos do concurso da Camara dos Deputados se dividem em escolaridade e critérios básicos para a investidura.

  • Escolaridade : para Analista e Técnico, diploma de nível superior em qualquer área emitido por instituição reconhecida pelo MEC.
  • Aprovação : ser aprovado em todas as etapas do concurso público.
  • Nacionalidade : brasileiro ou português (amparado pelo Estatuto de Igualdade entre brasileiros e portugueses).
  • Direitos políticos : estar em pleno gozo.
  • Obrigações militares e eleitorais : regularidade no serviço militar (sexo masculino) e na justiça eleitoral.
  • Idade mínima : 18 anos completos na data da posse.
  • Saúde : aptidão física e mental para exercer as funções do cargo.
  • Lotação : após a posse, permanecer na unidade administrativa de primeira lotação em Brasília/DF por pelo menos 3 anos antes de solicitar movimentação.

Esses critérios garantem que apenas candidatos que atendam às exigências legais e acadêmicas possam ser nomeados e exercer suas funções de forma adequada.

Sistema de Cotas e Procedimentos para Candidatos PCD

O concurso da Camara dos Deputados contempla políticas inclusivas, com cotas para diferentes grupos e vagas específicas para pessoas com deficiência, visando garantir igualdade de oportunidades. Essa classificação amplia o acesso ao serviço público.

Sistema de Cotas para o Concurso da Camara

O edital aplica uma reserva de vagas de 35% do total, distribuída da seguinte forma:

  • Pessoas com Deficiência (PCD) : 5% das vagas, além de outras oportunidades gerais disponíveis.
  • Cotas Raciais e Sociais (Lei 15.142/2025): 30% do total, distribuídas entre:
    • Negros (Pretos e Pardos): 25%
    • Indígenas: 3%
    • Quilombolas: 2%

Essa divisão visa diversidade e inclusão no quadro de servidores, permitindo que candidatos de diferentes perfis participem do concurso em condições equitativas.

Procedimentos para Candidatos PCD

O processo de comprovação da deficiência envolve etapas:

  • Inscrição : autodeclaração e envio, via upload, do laudo médico (validade de 36 meses, salvo deficiências irreversíveis ou autismo, com validade indeterminada).
  • Análise documental : equipe multiprofissional avaliará os documentos.
  • Avaliação telepresencial : em caso de dúvida, convocação para banca via Microsoft Teams.

Atenção: ausência na chamada virtual ou falhas técnicas podem comprometer o direito às cotas.

Como se Preparar para o Concurso da Camara dos Deputados?

Preparar-se exige disciplina, planejamento e estratégia. Organize os estudos de forma estruturada, definindo metas diárias e semanais, priorizando conteúdos mais recorrentes nas provas anteriores. Mantenha rotina de revisão e prática para aumentar a retenção.

Recomenda-se:

  • Planejamento de estudos : horários fixos e divisão por temas e disciplinas.
  • Resolução de exercícios : praticar provas anteriores e simulados para identificar dificuldades.
  • Materiais confiáveis : livros, apostilas e plataformas reconhecidas.
  • Revisão periódica : revisar tópicos estudados para evitar o esquecimento.
  • Saúde e bem-estar : alimentação equilibrada, sono adequado e pausas regulares.

Acompanhar atualizações do concurso e notícias relacionadas auxilia na contextualização de conteúdos e no preparo geral, aumentando as chances de aprovação.

Conclusão

O concurso da Camara dos Deputados representa uma oportunidade única para ingressar no serviço público com estabilidade, benefícios atrativos e possibilidades de crescimento profissional. Ao longo de todo o processo, é essencial conhecer os cargos, requisitos, cotas e etapas, garantindo decisões seguras e planejadas.

Com preparo adequado, organização dos estudos e atenção às regras do edital, os candidatos aumentam as chances de sucesso. A revisão de conteúdos, prática de exercícios e disciplina diária contribuem para um desempenho consistente e competitivo nas provas.

Em suma, dedicação e estratégia transformam o processo seletivo em uma oportunidade real de conquistar uma vaga, iniciando uma carreira sólida e bem estruturada na Câmara dos Deputados.

Job Duties

  • Assists in the education and training of new employees, students, and other ancillary personnel.

  • Technical School Diploma Graduate of accredited Radiography program or equivalent

  • Ability to deal effectively and ethically with medical and confidential information relating to patients, family, and physicians.

  • Knowledge of medical technology and terminology.
  • American Heart Association Basic Life Support - State of Pennsylvania
  • RT - Registered Technologist Radiology - State of Pennsylvania Upon Hire
Preferred Qualifications
  • Associate’s Degree Graduate of Health Science Program

About The Role

You’ll combine strategic oversight with hands‑on involvement, ensuring that every design project meets the highest standards of excellence.

You will report to the Director of Creative and play a key role in guiding a talented team of designers, overseeing the delivery of exceptional designs for paid ads, emails, landing pages, and e‑commerce web design. With your deep expertise in UI/UX and brand design, you’ll empower your team to elevate their skills while maintaining a high bar for creative output and attention to detail.

This role requires a balance of leadership and creativity in a fast‑paced, collaborative environment, where you’ll work closely with marketing, product, and development teams to ensure the alignment of design goals with broader business objectives. Your ability to drive creative strategy and manage multiple projects with precision will be essential to your success. This is a fully remote role operating in the EST Time Zone and all business is conducted 100% in English.

  • Manage a team of designers, starting with 2–4 direct reports and expanding as the team grows. Provide support in strategy, project management, design feedback, performance evaluation, and handling escalations.

  • Manage design projects independently from discovery to hand‑off, adhering to timelines and collaborating with developers to ensure feasibility.

  • 3–6+ years of senior‑level design experience, with at least 1 year of people‑management experience preferred. Must have experience in responsive web design.

  • Experience collaborating with developers and documenting designs for development hand‑off.

We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world‑class talent building something remarkable.

We believe in autonomy with accountability, truth over comfort, and outcomes over optics. If you want to build and win alongside some of the smartest people in the business, you’ll thrive here.

  • Endless opportunities for growth: Our agency is founded on an interdisciplinary approach, giving Darkroomers insights into services far beyond your job description. Somos a RHI Magnesita, a força que move a indústria refratária. Dominamos altas temperaturas para que as indústrias do mundo todo construam uma vida moderna e sustentável. Acreditamos que atuar de forma pragmática, positiva e integrada torna as equipes mais fortes e traz melhores resultados.

Compromisso com a diversidade

Somos uma empresa formada de gente. E gente significa diversidade: de ideias, de gênero, de cores, de raças, de vivências, de corpos, de mentes. Temos o compromisso de oferecer oportunidades iguais a todos, independentemente de sexo, raça, deficiência, etnia, orientação sexual, idade ou qualquer outra característica. Nubank was founded in 2013 with the purpose of freeing people from a bureaucratic, slow, and inefficient financial system. Sobre a empresa

A Vittude é referência no desenvolvimento e gestão estratégica de programas de saúde mental para empresas, sendo parceira dos maiores empregadores do Brasil. Com um ecossistema de soluções inteligentes em saúde mental, desenvolve projetos apoiados em 4 pilares: diagnóstico, educação, clínica e inteligência. Atende mais de 200 clientes, entre eles Grupo Boticário, Sodexo, SAP, Ipiranga Petróleo, Leroy Merlin, Yamaha Motors, Arcos Dourados, IFood, Thomson Reuters e Syngenta, possuindo mais de 3,5 milhões de pessoas beneficiadas por suas soluções. Nossos valores são elementos fundamentais para inspirar e orientar a Vittude na realização de nossa missão e propósito de existência.Eles atuam como uma bússola de conduta e framework estratégico que influenciam todas as facetas da operação da empresa.COLABORAÇÃO É ESSENCIAL: a colaboração é o motor que move nosso crescimento. Como os múltiplos ‘Vs’ em nosso isotipo, cada membro da nossa comunidade contribui para a integridade e a força de todo o ecossistema. O trabalho em equipe, a comunicação, parceria e a troca com nossos clientes criam o espaço para a construção para a construção conjunta e permitem que nossos sonhos e conquistas sejam compartilhadas.TEMOS CORAGEM PARA INOVAR: a coragem é a chama que ilumina o caminho da inovação e do pioneirismo. Ela nos inspira a desafiar o status quo, a quebrar paradigmas e abraçar a mudança com determinação. No empreendedorismo nos arriscamos, agimos com ousadia e aprendemos com nossos erros. Nossa coragem alimenta nossa vontade de liderar transformações significativas na sociedade. Com coragem olhamos para o futuro com a convicção de que somos capazes de moldar um amanhã melhor, onde a saúde mental é inegociável!SOMOS COMPROMETIDOS COM A EXCELÊNCIA: a excelência é a bússola que orienta cada aspecto do nosso trabalho, um símbolo do nosso foco e compromisso com a qualidade. Com persistência e resiliência defendemos uma remuneração justa e equilibrada para nossos psicólogos, pois sabemos que eles são peças fundamentais na evolução da saúde mental da sociedade. Priorizamos a sustentabilidade de toda a cadeia, entregando melhores resultados e eficiência para todos os nossos stakeholders.VALORIZAMOS A FRANQUEZA: a franqueza é a chave para a construção de relações autênticas e fortalecimento dos laços de confiança. Ela é o catalisador que guia nossas interações, nutrindo um ambiente onde as conversas difíceis são realizadas com cuidado e respeito. Incentivamos a construção espaços onde a segurança psicológica é a base para a transparência, a escuta empática, o feedback honesto, a compreensão e o crescimento mútuo.
AGIMOS COM RESPONSABILIDADE: a responsabilidade é o princípio que rege nossa forma de atuar, onde a autonomia e a flexibilidade são pontes para promover mudanças. Com responsabilidade criamos um alicerce onde a aprendizagem, a transformação positiva e a liderança promovem a reconstrução de uma sociedade pautada na saúde mental.

title: Manager, Finance LN_FR
description:
RÉSUMÉ DU POSTE

Responsable de s’assurer que la gestion financière et la comptabilité sont conformes aux politiques et procédures des donateurs, du développement et de la supervision des questions de conformité.

Principales Tâches et Responsabilités

Comptabilité et gestion financière

  • Collabore étroitement aux opérations comptables quotidiennes et aux fonctions de gestion financière dans les bureaux extérieurs, en veillant à ce qu'elles soient exécutées conformément aux politiques et procédures internes.
  • Organiser et développer les activités nationales dans les domaines de la finance, de la comptabilité, de la planification, du contrôle interne et de l'audit, de la facturation, du contrôle des crédits et de la collecte des liquidités.
  • Fournir à la direction du pays les informations financières appropriées conformément aux procédures comptables et aux règlements des donateurs.
  • Assurer les flux de trésorerie dans le pays et veiller à satisfaire les besoins de liquidités. Communiquer les paiements échelonnés en souffrance au donateur, le cas échéant.
  • Examiner et comptabiliser les opérations d'approvisionnement afin de garantir l'adéquation des pièces justificatives, l'exactitude des montants et le contrôle des paiements.
  • Proposer des formats pour les rapports financiers afin d'aider les utilisateurs des états financiers à mieux comprendre le contenu des rapports à des fins de prise de décision et de planification stratégique.
  • Assurer la tenue de registres précis des transactions financières du bureau national (bureaux principaux et de terrain) afin de contrôler la situation financière de toutes les activités du projet.
  • Aider à la gestion du service financier du pays afin de répondre aux exigences en matière de rapports financiers de la direction du pays et du siège; veiller à ce que tous les rapports financiers soient soumis dans les délais et contiennent des informations pertinentes pour tous les utilisateurs.
  • Diriger la préparation de l’ensemble des rapports financiers à des fins externes dans le respect des exigences comptables, légales et contractuelles.
  • Gérer le système comptable en veillant à ce que l’ensemble des données comptables soient mises à jour, rapprochées et entièrement justifiées; veiller à l'exactitude et à la mise à jour de la clé de répartition conformément aux pratiques d'IMC.
  • Superviser les comptes créditeurs et débiteurs, veiller à ce que les analyses mensuelles soient disponibles, rapprochées et tenues à jour, et que les ajustements nécessaires soient traités en temps opportun.
  • Superviser la formation du personnel financier et fournir un support technique au programme national et à la logistique.
  • Assister et/ou préparer les budgets.
  • Présenter et faciliter l'examen des dépenses budgétaires réelles avec les détenteurs de budget et d'autres membres du personnel de gestion du pays; formuler des recommandations pour des réalignements budgétaires lorsque nécessaire.
  • Superviser et analyser la préparation des budgets opérationnels pour chaque site et consolider le budget principal du bureau national; mettre à jour le budget principal chaque trimestre et communiquer avec l'équipe de gestion du pays pour assurer la couverture des coûts globaux.
  • Veiller au respect des réglementations et procédures internes et des donateurs; appliquer les politiques, les systèmes et les procédures des finances et des fonctions de support et diriger ou assurer leur élaboration, documentation et mise en œuvre.
  • Le cas échéant, travailler en étroite collaboration avec les RH pour le recrutement et la sélection de personnel financier qualifié, recommander des promotions, des mesures disciplinaires et des licenciements pour le personnel financier, en concertation avec les superviseur(se)s.
  • Maintenir une ligne de communication ouverte avec l'ensemble du personnel de terrain et de l'entreprise, le cas échéant.
  • Entretenir des échanges fréquents avec le/la directeur(trice) administratif(ve) et financier(ère)/directeur(trice) financier(ère) afin de s'assurer que les activités et objectifs financiers sont communiqués.
  • Travailler avec le personnel chargé des programmes et de la logistique pour veiller à ce que la coordination des programmes soit conforme aux objectifs fixés dans le budget.
  • Assister aux réunions de coordination pertinentes pour les activités du pays.
  • Assurer l'interface avec le gouvernement national et les agences concernées afin de garantir la conformité avec les différentes réglementations gouvernementales, le cas échéant.

Audit

  • Faciliter et coordonner divers examens et audits internes et externes, y compris l'audit statutaire annuel, l'audit spécifique des projets des donateurs et l'audit annuel de l'organisation.
  • Veiller à ce que les documents demandés par les auditeurs soient complets et fournis en temps opportun.
  • Coordonner la préparation et examiner la réponse de la direction du bureau national aux conclusions de l'audit.
  • Le cas échéant, lancer une demande de services d'audit en temps opportun pour s'assurer que l'audit est effectué dans les délais prévus.
  • Mettre en œuvre et/ou coordonner la mise en œuvre des recommandations provenant de divers audits.
  • Tenir à jour le suivi des audits, y compris les demandes/réponses d'audit.

Représentation

  • Assurer la liaison avec les donateurs sur les questions liées au programme afin de garantir la responsabilité financière et programmatique à l’égard des donateurs.
  • Participer aux réunions des donateurs et communiquer les informations pertinentes au/à la directeur(trice) administratif(ve) et financier(ère) et au/à la directeur(trice) pays.
  • Participer aux activités visant à assurer une visibilité maximale de l'agence au sein de la communauté des ONG.
  • Participer à la production de rapports et veiller à la ponctualité et à l'exactitude des informations fournies, ainsi qu'à la confidentialité des informations sensibles.
  • Contribuer à la création d'une image positive et à la crédibilité globale de l'organisation, notamment par l'application du code de conduite, de l'éthique, des valeurs et du point de vue de l'organisation à l'égard des acteurs internes et externes.

Formation / Renforcement des capacités

  • Former le personnel national à accroître ses responsabilités afin de renforcer les capacités et d'assurer la durabilité des programmes.
  • Défendre et planifier le développement professionnel du personnel national.

Effectuer les autres tâches qui lui sont confiées. Les fonctions et responsabilités énumérées dans le présent document sont représentatives de la nature et du volume du travail assigné et ne sont pas nécessairement exhaustives.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Généralement, un diplôme universitaire de 4 ans en comptabilité ou en administration des affaires. Une combinaison équivalente de formation et d'expérience pertinentes peut être acceptée le cas échéant.
  • Généralement, 7 ans ou plus d'expérience progressive pertinente dans le domaine financier, dont au moins 5 ans d'expérience dans la gestion administrative et financière de programmes à l'étranger.
  • Capacité à travailler dans un environnement de sécurité hautement volatile et complexe est requise.
  • Expérience approfondie des systèmes comptables informatisés; une expérience des systèmes ERP est un atout.
  • Expérience en matière de rapports aux donateurs, de préférence USAID, OFDA, donateurs de l’ONU, ECHO et autres donateurs privés.
  • Capacité à travailler de manière autonome avec un minimum de soutien technique.
  • Connaissance des règlements financiers des donateurs variés.
  • Expérience en gestion des procédures et politiques d'approvisionnement et de logistique.
  • Qualités de leadership avérées; expérience de travail avec une grande équipe nationale.
  • Solides compétences en négociation, relation interpersonnelle et organisation.
  • Capacité à travailler dans un environnement peu structuré, à fixer des priorités et à gérer de nombreuses exigences simultanées.
  • Capacité à lire, écrire, analyser et interpréter des textes techniques et non techniques en anglais.
  • Capacité à présenter efficacement des informations et à répondre aux questions de cadres supérieurs sur le terrain et au siège, des homologues, du gouvernement, des communautés locales et d'autres acteurs régionaux concernés.
  • Maîtrise de l'anglais, écrit et parlé; d'autres langues (par exemple le français ou l'arabe) peuvent être requises selon le poste et le pays.

title: Backend Engineer (Global Bank Tribe)
description:
Join to apply for the Senior Backend Engineer (Global Bank Tribe) role at SumUp

Join to apply for the Senior Backend Engineer (Global Bank Tribe) role at SumUp

SumUp enables businesses to get paid easily, process orders quickly, sell online instantly and manage their money more efficiently. We create the tools businesses need to make their business and their customer experience thrive!
As a key member of the Global Bank tribe, you’ll play a key part in helping us build SumUp's own digital bank. You’ll be part of a global, autonomous, cross-functional team that takes an aspect of our product and perfects it from concept to execution. Becoming a part of the Global Bank Tribe means working alongside ~200 people of 32 nationalities across Cologne, Berlin, São Paulo, Santiago, Sofia, and Vilnius who love to take ownership, work with purpose, and help businesses thrive.
As a Senior Backend Engineer for our tribe , you will be responsible for evolving and maintaining the Brazilian side of the Transfers and Cards ecosystem inside SumUp Global Bank tribe, working within a highly-available platform that operates with money transfers in various payment systems.
This role is hybrid (3x/week onsite) from our office located in São Paulo, Pinheiros.
What You’ll Do

  • Evolve and maintain the Brazilian segment of the Transfers ecosystem within SumUp Global Bank tribe.
  • Supporting the transition from a localized setup with regional banks to a unified Global Bank
  • Design, implement, and iteratively develop highly available backend services, while continuously evaluating and implementing new methods to ensure the high reliability of transfer systems
  • Maintain and improve core services utilizing a modern, cloud-native technology stack (AWS), with microservices (Docker, K8s) written in Go/Kotlin and Elixir.
  • Design, implement, and iteratively develop highly available backend services.
  • Improve test coverage for existing services and own the end-to-end delivery of changes, including testing, observability, and monitoring.
  • Continuously improve our engineering culture by refining best practices, clarifying problems and opportunities, prototyping solutions, providing comprehensive documentation, and selecting new tools and technologies.
You’ll be great for this role if
  • You are proficient in one or more modern backend languages, we use: Golang, Elixir, Kotlin, Java, Ruby, or one functional programming language.
  • You are experienced in developing and maintaining distributed microservices and RESTful APIs
  • You have prior experience with modern cloud technologies (AWS, Docker, Kubernetes).
  • You are knowledgeable in event streaming platforms and messaging brokers such as Kafka and RabbitMQ
  • You have demonstrated an ability to learn new languages and technologies
  • You feel comfortable working with SQL and NoSQL databases
  • You have experience with CI/CD products such as GitHub Actions, Jenkins, ArgoCD
  • You take pride in your work, have a keen sense of ownership, and are dedicated to writing clear, maintainable, and testable code.
  • You’re a product-focused engineer who is passionate and curious about solving user challenges.
  • Have great English communication skills - you'll be part of a truly global team!
Why you should join SumUp
  • We’re a truly global team of 3200+ people from 80+ countries, spread across 4 continents
  • The opportunity to work on large-scale fintech products used by millions of small businesses around the world
  • A dedicated annual Learning & Development budget (R$10.000/ year) for attending conferences and/or advancing your career through further education
  • Enrollment in our virtual stock ownership program - you will own a stake in SumUp’s future success
  • A corporate pension scheme
  • The opportunity to work on large-scale fintech products used by millions of businesses around the world
  • Access to the SumUp Sabbatical, our Employee assistance program for mental health as well as Fitness and language learning benefits.
  • You’ll attend global offsites and/or hackathons
About SumUp
Be empowered to do more that matters.
At SumUp, we're on a mission to empower small businesses across the globe by providing simple and affordable tools that allow them to thrive. Today, over 4 million businesses in 36 markets rely on SumUp as their financial partner to manage payments, finance, and customer relationships.
Our commitment to small businesses is reflected in our diverse team of over 3,000 SumUppers from over 90 nationalities, united by global collaboration and an innovative mindset. Our core values lay the foundation for who we are and what we stand for, shaping our work culture and driving our success. We foster inclusivity and a continuous learning culture, providing a safe space for personal and professional growth. Our differences make us unique and strong as we strive to create an environment where everyone belongs and feels supported, no matter how they identify.
SumUp is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer, actively seeking and embracing diversity in our workforce. We don't make hiring or employment decisions based on race, colour, religion or religious belief, ethnic or national origin, nationality, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, age or any other basis protected by applicable laws or prohibited by company policy. Our commitment extends beyond recruitment to creating a safe and respectful workplace where harassment of any form is strictly prohibited.
Explore career opportunities with us and join a team driven by collaboration, innovation, and a shared vision of creating a world where everyone can build a thriving business. Discover more about our vibrant and inclusive work culture and how we work on our careers website, and follow our journey on LinkedIn and Instagram.
Job Application Tip
We recognise that candidates feel they need to meet 100% of the job criteria in order to apply for a job. Please note that this is only a guide. If you don’t tick every box, it’s ok too because it means you have room to learn and develop your career at SumUp.

WHY JOIN US
If you're looking for a place to grow, make an impact, and work with people who care, we'd love to meet you!
ABOUT THE ROLE
As a Sales Engineering Delivery Manager, you will serve as the crucial link between our prospective clients and internal teams. In this role, you will lead technical discovery sessions and consultative introduction calls, gather essential engagement details (such as timelines, budgets, skillset requirements, risks, and SWOT analyses), and translate these insights into impactful proposals. This position requires a strong grasp of both business strategy and the software development lifecycle (SDLC), along with outstanding communication and design skills to create engaging, high-quality deliverables.
WHAT YOU WILL DO
Technical Discovery Call & Stakeholder Engagement:
- Assemble Sales Support Engineering team, align them on preliminary information, following internal RACI procedures;
- Lead the Technical Discovery call, showcasing outstanding interpersonal skills with the ability to build rapport and trust quickly;
- Demonstrate in-depth knowledge of the SDLC—from ideation and inception, through discovery and development, to market release—to guide discussions and identify project feasibility;
- Use consultative questioning techniques to uncover client pain points and business objectives, extracting and analyzing high-level requirements such as project timeline, budget constraints, technical skill requirements, and risk assessments;
- Showcase strong presentation and storytelling skills, ensuring clarity and persuasion in all client-facing interactions, both during calls and via emails.
Proposal Development & Deliverable Creation:
- Develop dynamic, visually compelling presentation decks and engagement proposals that clearly articulate service offerings, project scope, value propositions, and strategic recommendations;
- Customize deliverables to reflect client-specific challenges and opportunities uncovered during discovery meetings;
- Integrate technical insights with business strategy, ensuring that proposals account for both immediate deliverables and long-term client growth.
Team Buildout and Project Kickoff:
- Act as the primary point of coordination among Sales, Recruiting, and Engineering teams, ensuring smooth hand-offs from initial engagement through team buildout to project kick-off;
- Serve as a “concierge” for deals, maintaining fluid communication and alignment across functions to drive successful client onboarding;
- Serve as a trusted advisor during pre-sales engagements by translating complex technical aspects into digestible, business-focused narratives;
- Maintain a sales/consulting mindset throughout the technical discovery process, ensuring proposals align with targeted business outcomes.
MUST HAVES
-Exceptional Communication & Soft Skills: outstanding interpersonal skills with the ability to build rapport and trust quickly; strong presentation and storytelling skills, ensuring clarity and persuasion in all client-facing interactions.
UX & Presentation Design Acumen: solid grasp of user experience (UX) principles and design thinking, enabling effective discussion of digital product experiences; proven track record of creating high-quality, visually engaging presentation decks and proposals.
- Technical Savvy & SDLC Knowledge: a deep understanding of the software development lifecycle—from conceptualization through to market release—and familiarity with agile methodologies; capability to discuss technical nuances without losing sight of the business impact, bridging the gap between technical details and strategic outcomes.
Analytical & Strategic Thinking: strong analytical skills to synthesize complex information, identify key insights, and recommend actionable strategies; ability to prioritize client objectives while balancing technical feasibility and business goals.
- Team Collaboration & Cross-Functional Coordination: demonstrated ability to work effectively across multiple departments, managing internal communications as deals move from the funnel stage to the kickoff; capability to serve as a liaison, ensuring alignment and clarity among Sales, Engineering, and Recruiting teams.
- Consultative Sales Experience: prior experience in a pre-sales, sales engineering, or technical consulting role, ideally within a digital software consultancy or similar environment; ability to quickly assess client needs and transform them into actionable insights and proposals.
- English: Upper Intermediate English level.
PERKS AND BENEFITS
- Professional growth: Accelerate your professional journey with mentorship, TechTalks, and personalized growth roadmaps.
- Competitive compensation: We match your ever-growing skills, talent, and contributions with competitive USD-based compensation and budgets for education, fitness, and team activities.
- A selection of exciting projects: Join projects with modern solutions development and top-tier clients that include Fortune 500 enterprises and leading product brands.
- Flextime: Tailor your schedule for an optimal work-life balance, by having the options of working from home and going to the office – whatever makes you the happiest and most productive.

Join Avanto - A Leader in the Furniture Industry!

About Avanto:

Avanto is an innovative and forward-thinking company transforming the furniture industry through technology and a people-centric approach. We stand out for our cutting-edge solutions, exceptional service, and strong commitment to excellence, integrity, and innovation.

At Avanto, we foster an environment where employees can thrive both personally and professionally, promoting collaboration, continuous learning, and a results-driven culture. Our mission is to make a positive impact on the industry by driving change and continuous improvement.

About the Tech Lead / Architect

This role focuses on defining and evolving our sophisticated microservices architecture, establishing architectural patterns, and leading technical initiatives across frontend, backend, and infrastructure teams.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, evolve, and govern a scalable microservices architecture , including service boundaries and integration patterns.
  • Define and enforce architectural standards , coding guidelines, and best practices across engineering teams.
  • Evaluate, select, and standardize technologies, frameworks, and tooling aligned with long-term platform strategy.
  • Create reusable architectural patterns , reference implementations, and clearly defined golden paths .
  • Produce and maintain comprehensive architecture documentation , including ADRs, system diagrams, and technical specifications.

Technical Leadership & Collaboration

  • Partner with frontend, backend, and DevOps teams to ensure architectural alignment and consistency.
  • Participate in architectural and design reviews, providing guidance on complex technical decisions.
  • Mentor senior engineers and serve as a technical leader across the organization.
  • Lead architecture reviews, technical workshops, and internal knowledge-sharing sessions.
  • Contribute to the technical roadmap , platform evolution strategy, and technology adoption decisions.
  • Design platform-wide performance optimization strategies , including caching, scalability patterns, and resource efficiency.
  • Define security architecture baselines , covering authentication, authorization, and data protection.
  • Architect end-to-end observability solutions , including metrics, logging, monitoring, and distributed tracing.
  • Identify, prioritize, and drive remediation of technical debt across the platform.
  • Proactively identify architectural risks and design mitigation strategies to ensure system reliability and resilience.
  • Design and enforce tenant isolation , data security, and boundary enforcement mechanisms.
  • Define tenant-aware routing, schema management, and data access patterns.
  • Architect tenant validation frameworks, authorization checks, and security controls.
  • Ensure scalable resource allocation and performance optimization in a multi-tenant environment.
  • Define service boundaries, domain models, and inter-service communication patterns.
  • Design and govern RESTful and GraphQL APIs , including versioning and integration strategies.
  • Architect event-driven systems , including message queues and asynchronous processing.
  • Define service mesh patterns such as service discovery, load balancing, and circuit breakers.
  • Design AWS cloud architecture, including multi-account strategies and cost optimization.
  • Define Infrastructure as Code standards using Terraform, including secure state management.
  • Architect containerization and orchestration strategies.
  • Design secure and scalable CI/CD pipelines , deployment strategies, and environment promotion models.

Observability Architecture

  • Design distributed tracing solutions using OpenTelemetry and Jaeger.
  • Define metrics, dashboards, and alerting strategies using Prometheus and Grafana.
  • Establish structured logging, log aggregation, and analysis standards.
  • Define SLOs, error budgets, and reliability targets across services.

Critical Architectural Challenges to Address

  • Security : JWT validation, tenant isolation, rate limiting, input validation, credential management.
  • Performance : Connection pooling, caching strategies, query optimization, frontend performance budgets.
  • Observability : End-to-end tracing, correlation IDs, metrics completeness, alerting maturity.
  • Multi-Tenancy : Prevent cross-tenant access and enforce strong validation mechanisms.

You will lead the architectural design and execution of solutions addressing these challenges.

Service-Specific Architecture Ownership

  • API Gateway : Routing, security, performance, and observability patterns.
  • Identity Service : OAuth2, JWT, RBAC, multi-tenant authentication and authorization.
  • GraphQL Services : Schema design, resolver optimization, query performance, and security controls.
  • RFQ & Workflow Services : Event-driven procurement workflows and integrations.
  • Data Upload Services : Streaming, memory optimization, scalability, and security controls.
  • AI Services : Secure and scalable AI integrations, async processing, tenant isolation, and performance optimization.

Required Experience & Skills

Core Architecture Expertise (Must Have)

  • Microservices Architecture : Design and evolution of distributed systems; service (text incomplete).
  • Multi-Tenancy Patterns : Schema-per-tenant architecture, tenant isolation, data security, tenant-aware routing, infrastructure as code strategies.
  • Large-Scale Systems : 100,000+ lines of code, complex business logic, enterprise patterns.
  • Distributed Systems : Service mesh, service discovery, distributed tracing, circuit breakers.
  • Performance Engineering : Query optimization, caching strategies, load balancing, scalability patterns.
  • Security Architecture : OAuth2/JWT, RBAC, data encryption, audit logging, security baselines.
  • Observability : Distributed tracing, metrics, logging, SLOs, error budgets.

title: Attending Veterinarian | Paulínia (SP)
description:
Zoetis values and supports inclusion, and is committed to equal opportunities.

Position Summary

Responsible for upholding the highest standards of ethical care and welfare for research subjects at the Zoetis Research Center in Paulínia, ensuring full compliance with all company policies as well as relevant local and international regulations and legislation concerning research practices. Additional responsibilities include supporting in vivo studies, training colleagues, and providing backup in related procedures. The role also involves establishing and monitoring key welfare and care metrics across the research operations.

Responsibilities

  • In collaboration with area management, develop and maintain a high-quality care program to promote health, wellbeing, and regulatory compliance for research activities at the Paulínia site. Focus areas include: disease prevention, biosafety, sanitation, pest control, management practices, safe handling protocols, responsible medication use and storage, and humane endpoints.
  • Perform daily rounds throughout the site to conduct veterinary inspections, ensuring optimal welfare conditions and that teams adhere to established procedures.
  • Maintain comprehensive records for research subjects to ensure traceability and documentation of medical history.
  • Guarantee ready access to controlled and non-controlled medications for research needs.
  • In collaboration with CEUA, expand and apply knowledge regarding local regulations and Zoetis internal standards to support accreditation and sustain best practice requirements.
  • Ensure complete alignment with Zoetis policies and the laws and guidelines of relevant authorities such as CONCEA, MAPA, CRMV, and others.
  • Actively participate in committee meetings and protocol reviews, sharing relevant updates and decisions with site teams in partnership with area leadership.
  • Report and communicate any events or concerns related to research subjects according to internal protocols and external regulations, updating the global team and implementing preventive measures as needed.
  • Provide technical expertise in veterinary science to support Zoetis and VMRD objectives, meeting client needs and contributing to collaborative scientific and service outcomes.
  • Apply scientific principles and practices to the development of tools and technologies that advance research models for drug discovery and development.
  • Collaborate with project teams to support research initiatives, including protocol and model development.
  • Foster communication between VMRD and GMS, serving as a role model for the broader Zoetis organization and presenting results internally and externally.
  • Train, educate, and guide colleagues in best practices regarding clinical procedures, research handling, care, and experiment-related workflows.
  • Identify opportunities for continuous improvement, emphasizing the principles of the 3Rs wherever possible.
  • Serve as the representative of the Paulínia site on the Zoetis Global Animal Welfare Committee.
  • As part of contingency planning, support in vivo research activities when needed.
  • Proactively prevent unsafe practices by following established safety guidelines and ensuring proper use of personal protective equipment (PPE).
  • Maintain strict confidentiality regarding sensitive information.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Veterinary Medicine, with an active CRMV license for at least 5 years.
  • Previous technical experience with the facility's working species – poultry and rodents – is desirable.
  • Solid experience in animal facilities or in the animal health products industry is preferred.
  • Advanced English proficiency.
  • A master's or PhD degree is desirable to provide additional technical support to the research team.
  • Planning and organizational skills.
  • Ability to work effectively in a team.
  • Knowledge of Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) and Good Laboratory Practices (GLP) principles.
  • Strong interpersonal skills to ensure positive relationships with colleagues from other departments.
  • In-depth knowledge of animal welfare and relevant regulations.
  • Activities are primarily concentrated at the animal facility located in Paulínia.
  • Work is preferably performed while standing, and requires moving between multiple buildings within the facility. Access to each building that houses different species must be performed according to established standard procedures, including changing clothes, showering, and other relevant protocols.
  • The employee must be willing to work weekends and outside of regular hours as required, according to on‑call schedules and veterinary occurrences.
  • The collaborator must also be available for activities outside the Paulínia site, such as meetings at Zoetis units in Campinas and/or São Paulo, visits to service providers and suppliers, as well as participation in events related to the field.

About Zoetis

At Zoetis, our purpose is to nurture the world and humankind by advancing care for animals. As a Fortune 500 company and the world leader in animal health, we discover, develop, manufacture and commercialize vaccines, medicines, diagnostics and other technologies for companion animals and livestock. We know our people drive our success. Our award‑winning culture, built around our Core Beliefs, focuses on our colleagues' careers, connection and support. We offer competitive healthcare and retirement savings benefits, along with an array of benefits, policies and programs to support employee well‑being in every sense, from health and financial wellness to family and lifestyle resources.

description:
Python and Kubernetes Software Engineer - Data, AI/ML & Analytics

4 months ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1000+ colleagues in 70+ countries and very few roles based in offices. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing. We are hiring Python and Kubernetes Specialist Engineers focused on Data, AI/ML and Analytics Solutions to join our teams building open source solutions for public cloud and private infrastructure.
As a software engineer on the team, you'll collaborate on an end-to-end data analytics and mlops solution composed of popular, open-source, machine learning tools, such as Kubeflow, MLFlow, DVC, and Feast. You may also work on workflow, ETL, data governance and visualization tools like Apache SuperSet, dbt, and Temporal, or data warehouse solutions such as Apache Trino, or ClickHouse. Your team will own a solution from the analytics and machine learning space, and integrate with the solutions from other teams to build the world's best end-to-end data platform. These solutions may be run on servers or on the cloud, on machines or on Kubernetes, on developer desktops, or as web services.
We serve the needs of individuals and community members as much as the needs of our Global 2000 and Fortune 500 customers; we make our primary work available free of charge and our Pro subscriptions are also available to individuals for personal use at no cost. Our goal is to enable more people to enjoy the benefits of open source, regardless of their circumstances.
Location: This initiative spans many teams that are home-based and in multiple time zones. We believe in distributed collaboration but we also try to ensure that colleagues have company during their work hourse! Successful candidates will join a team where most members and your manager are broadly in the same time zone so that you have the benefits of constant collaboration and discussion.
What your day will look like

  • Develop your understanding of the entire Linux stack, from kernel, networking, and storage, to the application layer
  • Design, build and maintain solutions that will be deployed on public and private clouds and local workstations
  • Master distributed systems concepts such as observability, identity, tracing
  • Work with both Kubernetes and machine-oriented open source applications
  • Collaborate proactively with a distributed team of engineers, designers and product managers
  • Debug issues and interact in public with upstream and Ubuntu communities
  • Generate and discuss ideas, and collaborate on finding good solutions
What we are looking for in you
  • Professional or academic software delivery using Python
  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in a technical subject or a compelling narrative about your alternative chosen path
  • Confidence to respectfully speak up, exchange feedback, and share ideas without hesitation
  • Track record of going above-and-beyond expectations to achieve outstanding results
  • Passion for technology evidenced by personal projects and initiatives
  • The work ethic and confidence to shine alongside motivated colleagues
  • Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills
  • Experience with Linux (Debian or Ubuntu preferred)
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Appreciative of diversity, polite and effective in a multi-cultural, multi-national organisation
  • Thoughtfulness and self-motivation
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel twice a year, for company events up to two weeks long
Additional Skills That Would Be Nice To Have

The following skills may be helpful to you in the role, but we don't expect everyone to bring all of them.
  • Hands-on experience with machine learning libraries, or tools.
  • Proven track record of building highly automated machine learning solutions for the cloud.
  • Experience with container technologies (Docker, LXD, Kubernetes, etc.)
  • Experience with public clouds (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud)
  • Working knowledge of cloud computing
  • Passionate about software quality and testing
  • Experience working on an open source project
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.
