title: Solutions architect analyst
description:
Join to apply for the Solutions architect analyst role at Netvagas .

We are a global leader in the application and security industry. Our platform allows companies to operate with agility, reducing latency and increasing the reliability of their applications. We are focused on simplifying application building and looking for passionate and innovative individuals to join our team!

About The Position

As a Solutions Architect, you will be a specialist in Azion products, capable of translating and interpreting market trends and business challenges into scalable solutions. Acting as a Trusted Advisor, you will ensure best practices in the use of our platform and support the success journey of our clients. You will validate, test, and debug complex issues related to clients’ use of Azion systems, and research new technologies to deliver tailored solutions. As a Solutions Architect, you must be committed to scalability, performance, high availability, and security best practices, ensuring success across various industries such as Finance, E-commerce, Media, and Education.

You are highly technical, client-focused, and able to communicate complex concepts clearly, both in writing and verbally. You understand enterprise environments, argue from a technical perspective, and inspire confidence. You stay up to date with Azion’s platform and market innovations and most importantly, you take initiative and chase results.

Your Impact

  • Actively participate in the planning and structuring of integration projects;
  • Integrate client systems with Azion’s platform, guiding and configuring environments when necessary;
  • Be the go-to expert for Azion products and solutions;
  • Support Customer Growth teams in guiding clients through their success journey, including resolving questions and engaging with Product and Engineering teams;
  • Support Technical Support teams by acting as a platform expert;
  • Identify and propose improvements in both processes and products driven by customer demand or internal insights;
  • Research and propose effective solutions for complex and non-standard use cases (corner cases).

What You’ll Bring

  • Understanding (and eagerness to learn) about networks and how the Internet works;
  • Protocols: TCP/IP, HTTP/HTTPS, DNS, TLS, BGP;
  • Security solutions: Firewalls, WAFs, Bot Management, Rate Limiting, (M)TLS, Zero Trust, Paywall;
  • Configuration and use of proxies and reverse proxies;
  • Content Delivery Networks (CDN), including caching and edge caching;
  • Experience with troubleshooting techniques: connectivity, routing, protocol errors, web applications, application mapping, etc.;
  • Knowledge of web performance optimization: latency, throughput, load distribution, load balancing;
  • Experience with scripting languages (e.g., Python, BASH, JavaScript);
  • Proactive mindset for identifying and suggesting improvements;
  • Ability to handle multiple projects in an organized and collaborative way;
  • Ability to manage priorities, deadlines, and project delivery;
  • Willingness to stay updated with market technology trends;
  • Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Technology Management, or equivalent experience;
  • Intermediate English.

Bonus Points

  • Experience in consulting, technical training, or customer support;
  • Ability to analyze and define modern, distributed architectures;
  • Familiarity with distributed systems, microservices, and event/function-based integration;
  • Hands‑on experience with serverless and Function as a Service (FaaS) models, including Lambda Functions, Cloudlets, Workers, or similar technologies, with a focus on low latency, scalability, and orchestration;
  • Knowledge of streaming, distributed storage, high‑performance web servers, security, and cloud environments;
  • Advanced English and Spanish.

Benefits & Azion Way of Life

  • CLT hiring model;
  • Health and dental plan;
  • Flexible VR and VA (Flash Card), including during vacation periods;
  • Transport voucher without payroll deduction;
  • Annual internal hackathons;
  • Mobility allowance (additional amount for travel);
  • Freestyle (incentive to customize the workstation);
  • Stock options (according to policy);
  • Birthday day off;
  • TotalPass;
  • Flexible working hours (really flexible);
  • Nomad program to work from anywhere for up to 3 months a year;
  • Annual international exchange program.

FlexWork Model

We offer a FlexWork model that prioritizes acculturation and collaboration. For the first three months, you will work on‑site in the local office, an essential step in building solid relationships and a genuine connection with our values and culture. After this period, you will have the possibility to apply for the hybrid model, working on‑site at least three times a week. This approach balances interaction in person and autonomy, creating a dynamic and productive working environment.

Inclusivity Statement

At Azion, all applications are welcome, regardless of gender, sexual orientation, age, pregnancy, disability, ethnicity, color, country of origin, or religion. We believe that an inclusive environment contributes to our success and that respect is present in all our relationships.

  • Familiarity with security features such as WAF, access control policies, and authentication mechanisms.
  • Proficiency in writing and troubleshooting F5 iRules.

  • Strong English verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to convey technical information clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Good to Have

Qualifications

description:
Potencializar o valor dos dados para impulsionar a sustentabilidade dos nossos clientes . Como uma plataforma tecnológica de gestão e automação, somos especialistas em quatro verticais de negócio. 1 Fiscal - Inteligência e compliance para governança de documentos fiscais. 2 Logística - Tecnologia para automações e transformação digital do transporte. 3 Dispositivos - Monitoramento e gestão de dispositivos inteligentes corporativos. 4 Kubo - Plataforma para educação corporativa e gestão do conhecimento organizacional - LMS/LXP. A nossa visão é: Liderar os mercados onde atuamos através de soluções essenciais para o sucesso dos nossos clientes . Tudo isso conectado ao ESG, porque acreditamos que a responsabilidade ambiental, social e de governança são pilares fundamentais para o sucesso da NDD. Nossos produtos estão presentes em mais de 30 países e atendemos cerca de 20 mil clientes, e para fazer tudo isso acontecer temos 580 colaboradores e especialista!

Requisitos

Estamos em busca de um Key Account (Farmer) para o nosso time! Se você é movido por relacionamentos, resultados e crescimento sustentável, essa vaga é pra você! Buscamos alguém com perfil consultivo, capaz de transformar conexões em parcerias duradouras e gerar impacto real nos negócios dos clientes. Aqui na NDD, acreditamos que cada conta é um universo — e queremos alguém que saiba explorá-lo com inteligência, empatia e estratégia.

O que você vai fazer por aqui

  • Ser a ponte entre nossos clientes e as soluções NDD, atuando como parceiro estratégico e consultivo

Por que a NDD?

Porque aqui, o sucesso do cliente é o nosso sucesso. Valorizamos pessoas com brilho nos olhos, iniciativa e vontade de construir algo grande — juntas. Se você acredita em relacionamentos de longo prazo e quer crescer em um ambiente que une inovação e propósito, esse é o seu lugar.
